title: LINC00853 contributes to tumor stemness of gastric cancer through FOXP3-mediated transcription of PDZK1IP1
author: Hu, Zhao, et al.
materials: The level of LINC00853 was assessed based on The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) database and GC cell lines by RT-PCR and in situ hybridization. An evaluation of biological functions of LINC00853 including cell proliferation, migration, and tumor stemness was conducted via gain-and loss-of-function experiments. Furthermore, RNA pull-down and RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) assay were utilized to validate the connection between LINC00853 and the transcription factor Forkhead Box P3 (FOXP3). Nude mouse xenograft model was used to identify the impacts of LINC00853 on tumor development.

steps.title: Prepare gastric cell lines
steps.instruction: Obtain the four gastric cancer cell lines SGC7901, AGS, MGC803, MKN‑78 and the normal gastric epithelium line GES‑1 from the Cell Bank of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (Shanghai, China). Culture AGS cells in F12K medium (Gibco, NY, USA) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS, Invitrogen, MA, USA). Culture SGC7901, MGC803, MKN‑78 and GES‑1 cells in RPMI‑1640 medium (Invitrogen, MA, USA) supplemented with 10 % FBS. Maintain all cultures at standard conditions (37 °C, 5 % CO₂).

steps.title: Produce lentiviral particles
steps.instruction: Construct overexpression lentiviral plasmids for LINC00853, PDZK1IP1 and FOXP3 using the pcDNA3.1 vector (GenePharma, Shanghai, China) and shRNA lentiviral plasmids targeting LINC00853, PDZK1IP1 and FOXP3 using the pLKo.1 vector (Shanghai GenePharma Biotechnology). Co‑transfect each plasmid together with the appropriate packaging plasmids into 293 T cells to generate lentiviral particles according to the manufacturers’ instructions.

steps.title: Transduce gastric cells and assess efficiency
steps.instruction: Transduce the prepared gastric cancer cell lines with the produced lentiviral particles (both overexpression and shRNA vectors) using standard infection protocols. After 48 h post‑transfection, harvest the cells and determine transduction efficiency by performing RT‑PCR on the target transcripts.

steps.title: Stain cells for CD44
steps.instruction: Detach cells with 0.25 % trypsin–EDTA, wash, and resuspend them in PBS containing 0.5 % FBS. Add anti‑CD44 antibody (dilution 1 : 200, catalog no. 550989, BD Biosciences, USA) to the cell suspension and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Analyze CD44 by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: After incubation, collect the cells, resuspend them in PBS, and analyze CD44 expression using a FACSCalibur flow cytometer (BD Biosciences, California, USA).
